say:0:1110815001:0.text: Magister! It's Atalanta! Chippy didn't expect to see her here!
say:0:1110815001:0.source_cn: 主人！那是阿塔兰忒！没想到她也来风蚀飞地了！
say:0:1110815001:0.male: Magister! It's Atalanta! Chippy didn't expect to see her here!
say:0:1110815001:0.female: Magister! It's Atalanta! Chippy didn't expect to see her here!

say:1:1110815002:0.text: This isn't the time to act surprised! We should go help her!
say:1:1110815002:0.source_cn: 现在不是感慨的时候！我们得去帮忙！
